principals.name: A
principals.description: the initiator: sends the request and nonce to S, decrypts S's credential, verifies B with the session-key challenge, and proves possession of the session key to B.

principals.name: B
principals.description: the responder: decrypts S's credential for B, challenges A using the session key and a fresh nonce, and verifies A's encrypted response.

principals.name: S
principals.description: the trusted authentication server: shares long-term master keys with A and B, generates the session key, and encrypts credentials for both principals.

values.name: K_as
values.description: K_as is a pre-run symmetric key or keying value.

values.name: K_bs
values.description: K_bs is a pre-run symmetric key or keying value.
